page.notes: Running head: the chapter label "Cap. 2." was kept as printed alongside the title. The Greek word after "fabulæ" is not legible at this scan resolution and is marked as illegible. "Istocnè" is doubtful and marked [?]. The reference mark before "Etiamsi" and its margin note are read as "f" (long-s shape), which is uncertain. The word "cant" at the end of the quotation and "Quid ifti." in the margin are doubtful. The hyphenated word at the end of the last paragraph ("Pasto-") is partly unclear. The paragraph "Vnum est" is marked as ending on a broken word; the catchword "rali" is printed below the last line.
